author: everestmcarthur
install_msg:
Thanks for installing **ServerWhitelist**!

All servers the bot is currently in have been automatically whitelisted.

**Usage (bot owner only):**
• `[p]join <server_id>` — Add a server to the whitelist so the bot can stay when invited.
• `[p]join remove <server_id>` — Remove a server from the whitelist (the bot will leave it).
• `[p]join list` — View every whitelisted server.

Any server **not** on the whitelist will be left automatically when the bot joins.
name: ServerWhitelist
short: Restrict which servers the bot is allowed to stay in via an owner-only whitelist.
description: ServerWhitelist lets the bot owner control exactly which Discord servers the bot is permitted to operate in. On first load every server the bot is already in is auto-whitelisted. The hybrid command [p]join <id> adds a new server ID to the list. When the bot joins a server that is not whitelisted it immediately leaves. Subcommands let the owner remove servers and view the full whitelist. Only the bot owner can use these commands.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild IDs in a global whitelist. No per-user data is collected or stored.
